game.title: Frostline Zero
game.tagline: The avalanche is behind you, the abyss below. One hit and you are done — ride it to the finish.
hint.jump: {jump} jump the gaps — hold for distance
hint.bridge: Narrow decks — small taps, watch the gate gaps
hint.brake: {brake} brake to wait out pendulums and lasers
hint.crumble: Cracked ice collapses under you — keep moving
hint.slam: {slam} in the air to slam down — big drops give a boost
hint.ramp: Gold kickers launch you — aim the landing
hint.rail: Land on neon rails to grind faster — {jump} to switch
hint.sprint: Final sprint — the avalanche is speeding up!
pause.title: Paused
settings.title: Settings
results.rankNote: Each fall adds {s}s to the rank score
results.title: Title Screen
credits.fonts: Fonts: Sora, Figtree, Noto Sans SC (SIL OFL 1.1)
ctl.touch.steer: Drag the left pad to steer
ctl.touch.brake: Pull the pad down to brake
ctl.touch.jump: Tap or swipe up to jump (hold = higher)
ctl.touch.slam: Swipe down in the air to slam
hint.steer.touch: Drag the left pad to steer — dodge the red crystals
hint.jump.touch: Tap or swipe up to jump the gaps — hold for distance
hint.brake.touch: Pull the pad down to brake and wait out pendulums and lasers
hint.slam.touch: Swipe down in the air to slam — big drops give a boost
hint.rail.touch: Land on neon rails to grind faster — jump to switch
scenes.title: Scene Select
scenes.lead: Clear the glacier run to unlock a hotter, wilder route.
scene.glacier.title: Glacier Zero
scene.glacier.subtitle: The original frozen line
scene.glacier.description: Aurora ice, red crystals and the avalanche behind you.
scene.lava.title: Magma Run
scene.lava.subtitle: Molten canyon
scene.lava.description: Molten rivers and ember rain. Own soundtrack + erupting lava vents.
scene.blizzard.title: Whiteout Pass
scene.blizzard.subtitle: Whiteout frontier
scene.blizzard.description: A full whiteout. Own soundtrack + crosswinds that shove you sideways.
scene.cyber.title: Neon Circuit
scene.cyber.subtitle: Neon megastructure
scene.cyber.description: A neon canyon of scan rings. Own soundtrack + lane-jumping phase walls.
settings.steer.note: Tilt wheel: hold the phone the way you like, tilt like a steering wheel. Recenters at every start.
tilt.ready: Tilt wheel ready — tilt the phone to steer
tilt.denied: Motion access was denied — switched back to the thumb stick
tilt.unsupported: No motion sensor found — switched back to the thumb stick
mechanic.lava: Lava vents: a glowing vent is about to erupt — steer around the column
mechanic.blizzard: Crosswinds: the wind pushes you sideways — watch the arrow and counter-steer
mechanic.cyber: Phase walls: firewalls jump to the other lane when they flicker — take the open side
